## Technical Stack
- **Backend & Core:** Node.js, TypeScript, Python, Fastify, Express, REST APIs, GraphQL, Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Distributed Systems.
- **Data & In-Memory:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis (Caching, Streams, Distributed Locks), Prisma ORM, TypeBox, Zod.
- **Asynchronous & Queues:** BullMQ, AWS SQS, Idempotency patterns, Dead Letter Queues (DLQ), Circuit Breakers.
- **Cloud & DevOps:** AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS, S3, CloudFront, CloudFormation), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Docker Compose, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), Linux.
- **Frontend & Mobile:** React, React Native, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Next.js basics, State Management, Responsive Web Design.
- **AI & Integrations:** OpenAI API, Claude API, Anthropic SDK, Automated Prompt Pipelines, Webhook architectures, Payment Gateways (Stripe, Mercado Pago).

## Professional Experience Summary
- **Senior Fullstack Engineer** at Entropy Systems (Nov 2024 - Present):
  Architected asynchronous processing pipelines using Node.js, TypeScript, Redis, BullMQ and AWS SQS, handling 15,000+ operations/min and decreasing p95 latency by 38%. Designed idempotent payment webhook workflows processing $500K+ monthly.
- **Fullstack Engineer** at Entropy Systems (Feb 2024 - Nov 2024):
  Implemented microservices with Fastify, TypeScript, and Prisma ORM, reducing response times by 25%. Built AI-assisted automation agents with OpenAI API and Claude SDK saving 12+ team hours/week.
- **Fullstack Software Developer** at V3ntas (May 2022 - Feb 2024):
  Developed cross-platform mobile and web applications with React, React Native, and Node.js. Optimized SQL queries and Redis caches reducing database load by 35%.
- **Frontend Developer** at Web Informática (Mar 2020 - May 2022):
  Built responsive web applications, improved core web vitals and client interaction workflows.
